purpose: Strict anti-triviality, anti-mode-collapse, and shortcut prevention boundaries for the V6.3 dataset.

terminal_mule_district_match_rate.v6_3_mechanism: Stage-1 terminal geography deterministic contribution capped at <= 30.0%; reduced standalone terminal multiplier from 3.8 to 1.6.

dominant_account_district_match_rate.v6_3_mechanism: Stage-1 dominant account deterministic contribution capped at <= 30.0%; reduced standalone multiplier from 4.2 to 1.8.

maximum_single_cluster_share.v6_3_mechanism: Primary portfolio rotation across role-compatible clusters in each district + district-size normalization to dampen per-cluster case accumulation.

maximum_fraud_cluster_concentration.v6_3_mechanism: Fraud types map exclusively to broad functional role sets across all 11 districts without cluster ID preferences; marketplace fraud smoothed across 25+ retail/commercial clusters.

conditions: No single cluster probability may equal 1.0
No single district probability may equal 1.0
Every candidate cluster in realized district retains positive probability support

anti_gaming_rules.no_post_generation_quotas: The generator must NOT enforce hard artificial caps by pruning or reassigning rows post-generation.
anti_gaming_rules.no_benchmark_rejection_sampling: The generator must NOT reject generated cases based on whether they improve learnability or anti-triviality metrics.
anti_gaming_rules.organic_probability_generation: All pass/fail metrics must be the natural outcome of the generative probabilistic distribution.
